items.finding: To overcome limitations of single-modality workflows, future research should prioritize multimodal data fusion integrating interpretable modeling, standardized data protocols, and rigorous external validation.
items.how_it_applies: This supports testing whether combining multiple spectroscopic modalities improves classification robustness, though external validation on relevant tissue samples remains necessary.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The reviewed literature focuses on herbal materials and textiles rather than surgical tumor margins, so transfer risks are high due to completely different sample matrices and biological structures.
